query:
SELECT p.id
               FROM pictures p
               WHERE p.local_user_id = $1
                 AND p.remote_picture_id IS NULL
                 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
                 AND p.creator LIKE '#%'
                 AND ($3::text IS NULL OR p.creator = $3)
                 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tags t WHERE t.picture_id = p.id
                                                    AND t.tag_path <@ $2::text::ltree)
